card.name: The number three (or two) in quantities
card.fires_on: The number words three or two (also a digit 3 starting a number) when they give a count, duration or multiple. Often follows words like less than, first, in, or a patient group.

modes.label: Three after comparison or ordinal
modes.description: The word three after less than or the first, giving a time span or multiple.
modes.example: is left outside of the vagina for less than<< three>> hours

modes.label: Three or two as a count
modes.description: A number word starting a sentence or count of subjects or units.
modes.example: occurred in<< three>> subjects in association with mitral valve prol

modes.label: Two in age or day phrases
modes.description: The word two before years of age or day.
modes.example: Pediatric Patients<< Two>> Years of Age and Older

card.writes: It favors number-continuation words like consecutive and teenth, and disfavors the word two itself.
card.plain: It spots the small number words three and two when they state how many or how long.
